title.narrative: Nefco- Lviv Wastewater Treatment Plant , Ukraine

description.narrative: Investeringsbidrag för rehabilitering och uppgradering av avloppsreningsverket i Lviv, Ukraina. Total projektbudget uppgår till cirka 70 MEUR.
Investment grant for rehabilitation and upgrading of Lviv Wastewater Treatment Plant. The total budget for the project amounts to 70 MEUR.

The general objectives of the Lviv Wastewater project are to ensure (i) reliable and efficient operations at the WWTP and (ii) compliance of the treated WWTP effluent with the HELCOM Recommendation, EU Directive 2024/3019 and Ukrainian norms. It assures that design capacities of the WWTP are sufficient for future catchment growth until at least year 2035.
The specific objective of Project 1 Biogas is to reduce greenhouse gas emissions achievable through the production of heat and electricity from the biogas plant and at the same time homogenise and reduce sludge volume before final disposal. The specific objective of Project 2 Rehabilitation is to reduce the discharge of nutrients into downstream water-bodies, increase the capacity and energy-efficiency of the process technology to ensure sufficient generation of sludge.
No results reported as of yet.
